decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint builds directly on the firm's pipeline fittings and welding know-how, so the firm can read market feedback and refine it within its core infrastructure business.

The pipe support bracket draws on established steel fabrication and certified welding competence and fits the core customer base, though the earlier withdrawal of the similar bracket B shows some risk.

The powder-coated public waste bin uses the firm's coating and fabrication equipment, but it serves a market distant from its knowledge base, which limits how well the firm can learn from results, so it stays only with moderate risk.

The waste bin with ashtray line relies on existing powder-coating capability, but its several models in an unfamiliar street-furniture market strain absorptive capacity, so withdrawal is a real possibility.

The outdoor ashtrays are technically simple for a coating and fabrication firm, but they are far from its utility customers and own knowledge, which makes them a candidate for pruning, though not yet a clear drop.
